summary: Preserve current output failures in cached preflight reports

delivery.outcome: Combine current invocation path and resolved-ticket writer findings with cached preflight findings, summaries and exit status. Preserve legitimate cache reuse, existing warnings/timing, cache-disabled CI and approval boundaries; publish standard 0.20.77 after protected merge.
nonGoals: Grant CI, effect or approval authority from advisory cache data
Change cache keys, provider/model routing, ticket selection or lease policy
Change catalog/artifact, workflow parsing or schema identity
Add runtime dependencies or mutate foreign/frozen target state

architecture.decision: Evaluate each requested output operation once and combine any new Report findings with the cached payload before formatting and determining success. Preserve cache hits and cached findings, existing counts/timing and cache-off CI; synchronize the existing bundled checker. Actual CLI reproductions cover invalid report paths and both resolved-ticket path/writer failures, with later successful cache reuse. Test child processes activate the real managed hook through scoped Git configuration environment, without editing repository configuration, and use an available explicit Git base (origin/main or a verified parent), failing when no meaningful base exists.
interfaceChanges: Existing preflight CLI exposes current invocation failures and returns a nonzero status on a cache hit.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Actual CLI on source/bundle preserves cached results while rejecting unsafe report paths and resolved-ticket path/writer errors, exposes combined findings/counts, leaves denied targets unchanged and allows subsequent valid cache reuse. Fresh CI checkout prerequisites are provided only to child processes; no hook or diff check is bypassed.
Existing integration, wheel/parity, native and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and final standard v0.20.75 release verified.
